subject: No Revenge on PS
author: Xandu
body:
Burnout Revenge for PS2 can no longer be played online. The servers for this game was shut down back in 2007. Since the servers are no longer available it is not going to help trying to play the game on the PS3.

The only way Burnout Revenge can be played online is on the XBox 360.

-- The Creator --
